profile.name: 实验室磁体
profile.description: 用于在实验中产生和调节磁场的磁体装置，通常通过电流源驱动，并可按电流与磁场的换算关系进行控制。常用于量子器件、低温测量和材料表征等需要稳定外加磁场的实验。
profile.description_en: A laboratory magnet used to generate and control magnetic fields in experiments, typically driven by a current source and operated through a current-to-field conversion relationship. It is commonly used in experiments requiring stable external magnetic fields, such as quantum device studies, cryogenic measurements, and materials characterization.

registry.name: AMI Superconducting Magnet
registry.description: AMI超导磁体电源控制器，支持电磁场强度设定与持续电流模式切换。
